+# QuickJS
+
+QuickJS is a small and embeddable JavaScript engine. It supports the ES2023 specification including modules, asynchronous generators, proxies, and BigInt.
+
+## Features
+
+- Small and easily embeddable: a few C files, no external dependency
+- Fast interpreter with very low startup time
+- Almost complete ES2023 support (including modules, async generators, proxies, BigInt)
+- Passes nearly 100% of the ECMAScript Test Suite (test262)
+- Can compile JavaScript to executables with no external dependency
+- Garbage collection using reference counting with cycle removal
+- Mathematical extensions: BigDecimal, BigFloat, operator overloading
+- Built-in `std` and `os` modules for system interaction
+
+## Usage
+
+### Run a JavaScript file
+```
+qjs [options] file.js [args...]
+```
+
+### Evaluate an expression
+```
+qjs -e "console.log('hello')"
+```
+
+### Interactive REPL
+```
+qjs -i
+```
+
+### Options
+```
+-h  --help              list options
+-e  --eval EXPR         evaluate EXPR
+-i  --interactive       go to interactive mode
+-m  --module            load as ES6 module (default=autodetect)
+    --script            load as ES6 script (default=autodetect)
+    --strict            force strict mode
+-I  --include file      include an additional file
+    --std               make 'std' and 'os' available to the loaded script
+-T  --trace             trace memory allocation
+-d  --dump              dump memory usage stats
+    --memory-limit n    limit memory usage to n bytes
+    --stack-size n      limit stack size to n bytes
+-s                      strip all debug info
+    --strip-source      strip the source code
+-q  --quit              just instantiate the interpreter and quit
+```
+
+### std module
+Provides: `printf`, `sprintf`, `open`, `popen`, `tmpfile`, `puts`, `getline`,
+`readFile`, `loadFile`, `strerror`, `exit`, `gc`, `getenv`, `setenv`,
+`unsetenv`, `getenviron`, `urlGet`, `parseExtJSON`, `SEEK_SET`, `SEEK_CUR`,
+`SEEK_END`, `Error`.
+
+### os module
+Provides: `open`, `close`, `seek`, `read`, `write`, `isatty`, `ttyGetWinSize`,
+`ttySetRaw`, `remove`, `rename`, `realpath`, `getcwd`, `chdir`, `mkdir`,
+`stat`, `lstat`, `utimes`, `symlink`, `readlink`, `readdir`, `setReadHandler`,
+`setWriteHandler`, `signal`, `exec`, `waitpid`, `pipe`, `kill`, `sleep`,
+`setTimeout`, `clearTimeout`, `platform`, `Worker`.
+
